title: Baby Dodds tape, Ridgley's brothers and Celestin's age
summary: A Baby Dodds tape is mentioned, Ridgley's brothers were Spanish-American War musicians, and Celestin turns out to be older than Ridgley.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: No. I want to play a tape for you here, if I can find it.
That's old baby Dodds there. Yeah.
All he was is dead now. Your brothers?
Your brothers played, you say? You told me before, your brothers played music, huh? My brothers?

Oh, yeah. But they started in the Spanish War, you know. They were musicians in the American-Spanish War, my two brothers, but they didn't play no dance music. No. Well, what bands did they play with?
They didn't play with any band outside the Uncle Sam Band. Oh, yeah.
I thought maybe they played with some brass bands here or something.
No, no. No, no. No, no. I never did. Was Celestan as old as you or not? Well, you know, in the beginning I thought he was, but when he died he wasn't. I see.
He died. He grew younger instead of older.
Yeah, he grew younger, but Celestan was older than me.
